test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question: M is the sister of N and O. P is the father of O. Q is the mother of M. Considering this information, which of the following statements CANNOT be verified?

options.text: Q is the mother of N
P is the father of M

solution:
The family chart is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33df950b2ea2bd5c8083047b50162962b2e29f145586802f9b1cc3a4c6004dc8.png] 

Drawing the family tree as per the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b2fbafeee0f7988694188d90ea9ae0f5acc64729a6885e244c17f0776cc06e1.png] 

The gender of N is not confirmed, so N is Q's son cannot be verified.

Hence, **"N is Q's son"** is the correct answer.
